scope: Follow-up to the five-odd-prime null result, on exactly the same six paired fibres.
hypothesis: The exceptional directions gain a new local image at 2 or the real place, or the generic subgroup fails to match their seven local images simultaneously.
endpoints: Separate generic and witness image dimensions at 2 and infinity
Joint generic and witness image dimensions with the five pinned odd primes
Explicit generic corrections when they exist
dyadic_method: Use an order maximal at 2 only. At each prime ideal record valuation parity and even cyclic factors of units modulo P^(2e+1); the remaining principal units are squares.
real_method: Exact rational component criterion on y^2=x^3+A*x+B. For positive cubic discriminant the bounded component is x<0 or 3*x^2<-A; otherwise the real quotient is trivial. Verify with exact algebraic real roots.
bounds: Six sequential workers with 30-second timeouts and separate checkpoints. No BNF, global discriminant factorization, parameter sweep, or point search.
failure_semantics: Missing images, timeouts and verification failures remain UNKNOWN. No assertion about primes outside this declared set.
oracle_policy: Exceptional points appear only in retrospective diagnostics. Generic-image computations require no exceptional points.
non_interference: Import the existing LocalSquareclasses implementation without a cache adapter; do not modify the shared arithmetic store or active search files.
